annotations.title: Contact and sanctions screening (not identity verification)

description: Screen a name against sanctions lists, evaluate email deliverability and disposable signals, validate a phone number's numbering plan and inspect IP geography/network. Returns findings, per-check completion, and a screening risk indicator. Never proves document authenticity, ownership or liveness, and is NOT complete KYC or identity verification. Inconclusive/failed checks cannot produce a low-risk result. Input: any of name, email, phone, ip; optional country/birth_year. $0.10 per call. Returns: input{}, risk (low | review | high), verification_status (not_verified), assessment_status (complete | incomplete), check_statuses{}, flags[{code, severity, detail}], checks{sanctions, email, phone, ip}, checks_run[], checks_failed[], notes[], checked_at.

birth_year.description: Birth year, to narrow sanctions matches for a person.

country.description: Country the person says they are in (US or United States), compared with phone and IP.

ip.description: The client's IPv4 or IPv6 address.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name.description: Person or company name to screen against sanctions lists.

phone.description: Phone number, international (+44 20 7946 0958) or national with `phone_region`.

phone_region.description: Two-letter country for a national-format phone number.
